sources.excerpt: Fulltone Full-Drive3 | AllThePedals Articles Genealogy Browse Search results for " " Gain / Overdrive / Fulltone Full-Drive3 Full-Drive3 The Fulltone Full-Drive 3 is an overdrive pedal known for its tube-like sound, achieved through JFET input and op-amp circuits. It offers versatile tonal options with a 3-way clipping switch, providing symmetrical clipping, wide asymmetrical settings, and a comp-cut mode for a volume boost. It also features independent overdrive and boost channels, and a buffered bypass. A Dynamics knob includes a Germanium diode Limiter circuit for enhanced feel and tonal control. The Full-Drive 3 aims to deliver the characteristics of various other gain effects, such as the Marshall BluesBreaker . What Fulltone say about the Full-Drive3 Unlike its cousin the FD2, the FD3 uses both a JFET input and a JFET op-amp, giving it the most tube-like sound you can get out of a tubeless pedal. Along with great sound, these JFET’s give the FD3 an ultra-high Input impedance which allows the pedal to mate with any type/gain of pickup and react well to changes in your guitar’s volume control. 3-way CLIPPING toggle switch:set to 90’s and you’ll get symmetrical clipping with ample midrange.Set the switch to WIDE ASYM (wide asymmetrical) and more sweet highs and lows come through, along with chimey, Class-A style even harmonic overtones.set to COMP-CUT mode, pure opamp-overdrive, with no diode clipping assistance. Aggressive, cutting, and capable of a huge volume boost to slam the input of your amp. Discrete Channels:Unlike the FD2, the FD3 has completely independent OVERDRIVE and BOOST channels, and the ORDER toggle switch allows placing the BOOST channel* before* or after the OVERDRIVE channel. The BOOST channel is also an extremely transparent, high-headroom 100% JFET-powered circuit. Buffered Bypass:Serial# 2548 and higher FD3 pedals are now Buffered-Bypass instead of True-Bypass, so the FD3 will always drive long cables, be isolated from other effects, and always retain the highs and “feel” of your amplifier whether the pedal is turned ON or OFF. Do not confuse the hi-quality JFET op-amp buffer in the FD3 with the simple single transistor buffers on other pedals. The FD3's buffer sounds rich and fat, not thin. DYNAMICS knob:A Fulltone-exclusive Germanium diode Limiter circuit circuit that alters the feel of the notes being played as well as subdues transient spikes which can overload your amp’s input. This feature can make even a stiff amp feel responsive and juicy, and sweeten the treble frequencies. The Icing on the cake? The housing is about 20% smaller than the traditional FD2 SPECIFICATIONS:Input impedance: 1.1 mega-ohms. Output Impedance: 180 ohms. www.fulltoneusa.com Full-Drive3 compared to ... Fulltone Full-Drive3 (Full Tone) Overdrive/Booster --> --> --> --> --> Fulltone Full-Drive3 (Full Tone) Overdrive/Booster Reviews (0) $ 258.80 $ 129.40 Fulltone Full-Drive3 (Full Tone) Overdrive/Booster quantity Add to cart Categories : Auxiliary Percussion Description Reviews (0) The FD2 has been a huge hit since its release in 1993, and the Full-Drive3 is the ultimate overdrive boost pedal that continues to evolve from the original. It offers a more evolved, natural sound and a wide range of tones from clean to distorted. Unlike its siblings, the FD3 uses both a JFET input and a JFET op-amp, giving you the most tube-like sound you can get from a tubeless pedal. The JFET also gives the FD3 an ultra-high input impedance, allowing the pedal to be compatible with any pickup type/gain and responds extremely well to changes in your guitar’s volume control. Equipped with a 3-way CLIPPING toggle switch, it allows you to switch between the smooth, symmetrical clipping of the familiar 1990s FD2, and the aggressive boost of pure op-amp overdrive with ample midrange, sweet highs and lows, and finely textured harmonics. The OVERDRIVE and BOOST channels are completely independent. The ORDER toggle switch allows you to place the BOOST channel either before or after the OVERDRIVE channel. The BOOST channel is an extremely transparent, high-headroom, 100% JFET-powered circuit with buffered bypass, maintaining the amp’s high-fidelity sound and feel whether it’s on or off. Turning up the DYNAMICS knob on the BOOST channel (Fulltone’s proprietary germanium diode limiter circuit) changes the feel of the sound, suppressing transient spikes that overload the amplifier input. This feature makes even a harsh amplifier feel responsive and juicy, and sweetens the high frequencies. It can be powered by 18V DC, allowing you to enjoy an even bigger sound with more headroom.
